name: Draconic Manifestation Additions
body:
The following bonuses are meant for draconic sorcerers or bloodragers with a linnorm or drake bloodline who select the Draconic Manifestation feat.

Drake: Your claws are venomous and deliver poison in addition to the normal damage from the attack.

Venomous Claws—injury; save Fort (DC = 10 + ½ your HD + your Constitution modifier); frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Strength damage; cure 1 save. At 4th level, the poison deals 1 Strength point of damage and 1 Dexterity point of damage; at 8th level, it deals 1d2 points of both Strength and Dexterity damage.

Linnorm: You are under the effect of freedom of movement as long as you manifest your claws.
